meta.admin_checks: AdministratorAccess, or an attached or inline policy that allows * on * with no condition, or membership of an admin group. Not checked: permission boundaries, SCPs, NotAction, service wildcards such as iam:*.
meta.exposure_checks: EC2: security group open to 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, public IP, default route to an attached internet gateway, inbound network ACL rules. S3: public bucket policy (AWS policy status) or public ACL, unless Block Public Access (bucket or account) stops it. Lambda: function URL with AuthType NONE. Not checked: prefix lists, split default routes, load balancers, API Gateway, CloudFront, access points.
